content: Yesu kitanama ya boru vitarena
Raḡan 6 muridie Yesu na tauwai muriwatanama Pita, Jeims be tasinama Jon yai dokedi be taudiḡa oya daudaunama debane a naḡona.
Taudi oya debane a tavatavana, dabudi ta kitana be Yesu kitanama ya boru vitarena. Tauna noḡonama yai matakanikanina maika suara, be na garama a ḡavorana maika suara boruminama.
Inam kauinama ya tubutubuḡana nopone, ta kitana be Mousis be Elaija Yesu mate awai giuna a kitedina.
Naumeki be Pita Yesu ya riuena, “Bada, ya vere kauana da tauma mate uma dabudine. Deḡoda tam kwa ḡoena, taugu kape rabuiteḡa yà voiedina, tenaḡa tam aubaimma, tenaḡa Mousis be tenaḡa Elaija.”

Pita yaḡoro ya giugiu be giyou ḡavoḡavora tunutununama ya yovoyovona ya suma tawedina. Dabudine bona giyou nopone ya dobi be ya riuna, “Uma inam taugu natuḡomiguma, tauna ewai nuavereguna, bonanama ko vaiena!”
Be tauwai muriwatana nama giunama a vaivaiena, taudi a naira kaua, be noḡodie a beku be doḡae a ravusedina.
Naumeki be Yesu ya verau da ya taukonidi be ya riuna, “Ko midisuḡu, nam ko naira.”
Inam raḡanine taudi a tausuḡudi be ai kita da Yesu taunaḡa a kitana, be nam aitau ḡesau dabudi ti kitana.

Naumeki da taudi oyae be a dobi a munamunaḡana raḡanine, Yesu taudi umanama ya riuedina, “Taumi aba koya kitakitana nam aitau tenaḡa ko riue, naumeki da Banaga Natunama gurie be e kawa midisuḡu munaḡena.”
Dabudine tauwai muriwatana Yesu ai taravire be a riuna, “Aba aubainama tarawatu tauwai katakataidima ta riuriuna da Elaija tauna noḡone e yovo doka?”
Dabudine Yesu ya paribeedi be ya riuna, “Inam riukaua, Elaija tauna tokare e yovo doka be yaba matabudi e kawa nonoḡidina.

Be uma yà riuemina, Elaija tauna kaite ya yovona, be banaga tauna a nuababaḡena, vutuna aubainama taudi adi ḡoanama nama tauna ḡarone a voivoiedina. Inam banegidima tokare kauinama teneḡine nama Banaga Natunama ta raukivi gewegewe be ei nuatoitoina.”
Inam raḡanine na tauwai muriwatanama a kataiena, da tauna taudi ḡarodie Jon tauwai babataito ya giugiuena.
Yesu gomana penama kokukokunama yai yawasanina
Raḡanine taudi patara ḡarodie a dobidobina, dabudine tauḡoma tenaḡa ḡarodie ya tava be Yesu noḡone tuapikane ya raupari
be ya riuna, “Bada, natuguma kwa raunuatoie! Tauna muya e kawakawa guri, be e rarau gurerena. Tauna kana raḡanie e beku be kai matane e naḡonaḡona, be wari raḡanie upa nopone e naḡonaḡona.
Taugu è verauḡena am tauwai muriwatanama ḡarodie, da taudi a raurubuna, be nam ti yawasanina.”
Be Yesu ya paribee be ya riuna, “O banaga nam waisumeḡimi, ami nuababaḡama ya moraba ḡaḡa. Taumi mate tà mia ḡaḡa be yà noya ḡaḡaemi? Gomana ko verauḡe uma ḡarogue.”
Inam dabudine Yesu penama ya riutuaḡaie be penama gomana ya dobi porena. Naumeki da inam raḡanine gomana ya yawasana munaḡana.
Be tauwai muriwatana taudiḡa muriḡa a verau Yesu ḡarone da ai taravire be a riuna, “Aba aubainama tauma penama kè tavu be nam i naḡo?”

Be tauna ya paribeedi be ya riuna, “Inam baninama taumi nam ami waisumaḡama i morabana. Yà riuriu kauemina taumi ami waisumaḡama i morabana kai yauḡana pesinama maika, taumi tokare kaua oyanama koya riuena, kwa midisuḡu be noa dabudi kwa naḡo, be oya tokare ya naḡona. Be nam aiyaba tokare ḡaromie ya piripiri.
Penama inam nama kitedima tokare nam aiyaba e tauriedi, ibewa da widina be moiragie tokare e tauriana.”
Yesu nema e guri bakona, raḡan aniwai rabuinama ya giu munaḡena
Be tauwai muriwatana matabudi Galilima awai rawateḡeidina raḡanine, Yesu umanama ya riuedina, “Banaga Natunama kaiteka banaga nimedie ta boru nawena.
Be taudi tokare tai gurina, be raḡan wairabuiteḡane Mamaitua tokare tauna ei yawasani, be e kawa midisuḡu munaḡena.” Dabudine tauwai muriwatana nama a vaivaiena, taudi ai nuaboya kauana.
Tempol teksnama

Be Yesu na tauwai muriwatanama mate Kapeniamma a tavatavana raḡanine, tempol teksnama tautaminama baneginama ya tava da Pita yai taravire be ya riuna, “Ami tauwai katakataima tauna tempol teksnama ewai maesi bo ibewa?”

Naumeki da Pita ya paribee be ya riuna, “Ee, ewai maesina!” Be raḡanine Pita vadae ya saḡasaḡana, Yesu Pita yai taravira doke be ya riuna, “Saemon, tam aba kwa noḡonoḡoti, guyaguyau dobue aitau ḡarodie teks ta tamatama? Natunatuḡomidima ḡarodie bo banaga ḡesaudima ḡarodie?”
Dabudine Pita ya paribee be ya riuna, “Banaga ḡesaudima ḡarodie.” Dabudine Yesu Pita ya riuena, “Naumeki da tauda adi sedama aubainama nam tài maesa.

Be deḡoda tama kawa nopogewegewedi aubainama, kwa naḡo da topae kwa dobi da am kaimoma kwa porena. Be aba iyeninama kwa kaimo dokena, inam iyeninama gayane kwa kitana mane e kenakenana. Inam vutuna kwa paḡo da teks tautaminama kwa utena, taugu be tam aubaidama kwai teksna.”

footnotes.text: Gurik baibol ḡesaudima nopodie uma versnama 21 nam ima kenakenana.
